comparison.objective: Redistribute supplies so three emergency kits contain identical required inventories, versus tune a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-object sorting and relocation versus recessed-tool insertion, counterholding, continuous adjustment, locking, and cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Each kit must contain exactly one mask, torch, and dressing pack while preserving correct items; candidate requires quantified dynamic performance and retention.
comparison.reason: Inventory rebalancing does not test force-controlled mechanism adjustment or dynamic response.
